page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m4s.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture, this instance features 8 dedicated physical cores running at 2.9 GHz with a single thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB of RAM per core. For graphics and parallel computing acceleration, the instance is equipped with a fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU, delivering 4 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, and network connectivity is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier for general compute and memory operations. The Intel Xeon CPU achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1861.49 and a multi-core score of 13123.11. Memory read bandwidth for small cached blocks reaches 786.13 GB/sec, though larger uncached blocks drop to 70.29 GB/sec for reads and 36.07 GB/sec for writes, resulting in a weak Passmark memory score of 1621.48. In terms of specialized workloads, the fractional GPU configuration supports lightweight AI tasks, demonstrating an LLM inference speed of 165.78 tokens/sec for text generation on a small 135M model, though performance drops significantly to 7.03 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model.

The ecs.sgn7i-vws-m4s.2xlarge offers a resource-dense, cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring GPU acceleration without the overhead of a full dedicated GPU. By partitioning the NVIDIA A10 GPU, the instance reduces resource waste for entry-level graphics rendering, virtual workstations, and lightweight machine learning inference. This makes it highly suitable for remote 3D design, video transcoding, and small-scale model testing, while workloads requiring massive memory bandwidth or large-scale LLM execution may face performance bottlenecks.
